title.text: Hide a kind of place from its card

legend.text:
What changes (A, recommended): an unfound place's card on the walk gets More (…) at its top right, in ink, 44 pt; the kind moves from the title to a muted line under the name, so the title keeps one line at 320. More opens the app's bottom-sheet menu (as a moment's More): "Hide monuments and memorials", "What I’m into" (opens the page at that kind's row), Cancel. Hide switches that kind off in What I'm into (the same switch, nothing new stored), closes the card, and the kind's unfound pins leave the map at once. A line in the found line's look says "Hidden: monuments and memorials" with Undo and Close; it stays until used or dismissed (ui-patterns F3). It takes the place offer's slab (ink, two lines) rather than the one-line found pill, so a long kind is never cut at 320. (The after pictures are drawn over the far place's picture, where the pin could be lifted cleanly; the kind is an example.)

Reshaped after the owner's answer (Nov 21): a place of a subtype (a plaque, a bridge) offers both levels, "Hide plaques" (the rest of Monuments and memorials stays) and "Hide all monuments and memorials"; a place of a kind with no subtype offers only its kind. See the board at the right.

A "?" card's menu names the kind, never the place (the kinds are already said on Explore's card). A found place's card has no Hide: a find shows whatever its kind.

Rests on: matrix 3 "rare actions on an item go in More"; Google Discover's card More ("Not interested in …") and YouTube's More ("Don't recommend channel"), both read Nov 21; decision 0115, kinds filter what you see, never what exists.

What it does not do: no count, no colour, no "show less" weighting, no hiding of one place (asked separately), nothing on the capture row, which stays first and one tap.

B: the same Hide as a plain line at the card's foot, one tap, no menu; it adds a row to every card and puts a lasting setting a stray tap away.

redraw.text:
Redrawn to the owner's words (Nov 21): "a title subtitle of the point of interest where the subtitle is a kind, and the title is the cat[egory]".

More opens "Show on the map": the place's kind as the title row (Monuments and memorials) and its subtype as the subtitle row under it (Plaques), each a switch that acts at once, as on What I'm into. Turn Plaques off and only plaques leave the map; turn the title off and the whole kind goes, plaques with it. The switches are their own undo while the sheet is up, so no Undo slab; Done or a tap on the dimmed map closes it. A kind with no subtype shows only its title row. The card's own head reads the same way: the name, then "Monuments and memorials · Plaques". "What I’m into ›" opens the full page at that kind.
